title: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) Clinical Monograph
content: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen 500mg-650mg) is a first-line antipyretic and analgesic indicated for mild-to-moderate fever and body pain. Adult dosage: 500mg to 1000mg every 4-6 hours (max 4000mg per 24 hours). Contraindications: Severe hepatic impairment, alcohol dependency. Side effects: Rare at therapeutic dosage; hepatotoxicity in acute overdose.

title: Cetirizine Hydrochloride Clinical Guide
content: Cetirizine 10mg is a second-generation H1-receptor antihistamine used for symptomatic relief of allergic rhinitis, perennial allergic rhinitis, and chronic urticaria. Dosage: 10mg once daily at bedtime. Precautions: May cause mild sedation in sensitive individuals; avoid alcohol.
